title: Naturality of any normalized signed symmetry on K-flat representatives
statement: For a scheme X, a ring sheaf R, an ordinary tensor-Hom presentation a and a SignedSymmetry s as in def-sf-integral-verdier-models, take four K-flat complexes P,Pprime,Q,Qprime and chain maps f:P to Pprime and g:Q to Qprime. Then a.tensor(Qf,Qg) followed by s.swap(Pprime,Qprime) equals s.swap(P,Q) followed by a.tensor(Qg,Qf). No assertion about arbitrary derived arrows is needed.

proof.text: Maps from signed total tensor are determined by their values on local homogeneous pure tensors: use complex extensionality, the direct-sum inclusions and pure-tensor detection. Thus two SignedSymmetry structures on a agree on K-flat representatives.
Use the existing natural signed symmetry for the supplied normalized presentation. Replace its two components on K-flat objects by those of s, using uniqueness, and apply its naturality.

theorem signed_kflat_natural (X : Scheme.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X R)
    (s : IntegralVerdier.SignedSymmetry X R a)
    (P P' Q Q' : CochainComplex (IntegralHom.Modules.{u, u} X R) ℤ)
    (hP : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X R P)
    (hP' : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X R P')
    (hQ : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X R Q)
    (hQ' : IntegralHom.flat.{u, u} X R Q') (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q') :
    a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map f) (DerivedCategory.Q.map g)) ≫
        (s.swap (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P') (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q')).hom =
      (s.swap (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)).hom ≫
        a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map g) (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))
